name: Bonyhád (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Bonyhád (a red and blue shield with a patriarchal cross and a crescent, supported by two yellow lions, above a red scroll inscribed HŰSÉGGEL A HAZÁHOZ) below the name BONYHÁD in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Bonyhád arms with lion supporters and scroll
